intro.title: Introduction to Langdock Sync
intro.connectionHelp: In the Langdock Sync settings, save a workspace API key with the KNOWLEDGE_FOLDER_API scope. Select a knowledge base for which this key has the Editor role, then use “{test}”.
intro.scopeHelp: Select at least one folder. Subfolders are included. The default filter is classification: public. Adjust the property filters to refine your selection.
intro.syncHelp: Use “{preview}” to review uploads, updates, and deletions. Then select “{sync}”. Automatic sync starts off and can be enabled in settings.
